critical_code_review_comments: crm_quote_sage._validate computes net_total but uses unrounded float accumulation — minor accuracy risk on long quotes; consider summing rounded line nets.

Export VAT total is computed as net*vat_rate/100 at the QUOTE level, ignoring per-line tax_rate; if a quote mixes 20%/0% lines the CSV per-line VATCode is correct but the export record's vat_total/gross_total are wrong. Recommend computing vat_total as sum(line_net * line_vat) to stay consistent with VATCode-per-line.
_resolve_account_ref falls back to company sage_account_ref but companies query does not include organization_id scoping via _of(user) on cid lookup? Actually it does ({'id': cid, **_of(user)}) — OK.
GET /quotes/{id} single-resource endpoint missing in crm_v2.py — frontend has to list+filter. Consider adding a single-GET for cleaner client code (and easier deep-linking).
crm_quote_sage.py uses VAT_CODE_MAP with int rounding — fine for {0,5,20} but ensure UI input is constrained to these; otherwise everything else silently maps to T2 exempt which could be surprising.
